# Pharmaverse & Clinical Trial Data Science Assessment

This repository contains the code and deliverables for the Roche PD Data Science Assessment, covering SDTM domain creation, ADaM dataset derivations, and clinical reporting (TLGs) using the Pharmaverse R ecosystem.

***

## Repository Structure

```text
.
├── README.md
├── question_1_sdtm/
│   └── 01_create_ds_domain.R
├── question_2_adam/
│   └── create_adsl.R
├── question_3_tlg/
│   ├── 01_create_ae_summary_table.R
│   ├── 02_create_visualizations.R
│   ├── ae_summary_table.html
│   ├── plot1_ae_severity.png
│   └── plot2_top10_ae.png
└── question_4_python/
    └── clinical_assistant.py
    
Overview of Solutions
Question 1: SDTM DS Domain Creation
Tooling: {sdtm.oak} and {dplyr}
Script: question_1_sdtm/01_create_ds_domain.R
Description: Maps raw disposition data (pharmaverseraw::ds_raw) into the SDTM Disposition (DS) domain following SDTMIG v3.4 standard.
Question 2: ADAM ADSL Dataset Creation
Tooling: {admiral} and {tidyverse}
Script: question_2_adam/create_adsl.R
Description: Derives the subject-level analysis dataset (ADSL) using SDTM domains (DM, VS, EX, DS, AE). Key derived variables include:
AGEGR9 & AGEGR9N: Age groupings (<18, 18-50, >50)
TRTSDTM & TRTSTMF: Treatment start datetime and imputation flag
ITTFL: Intent-To-Treat population flag
LSTAVLDT: Last known alive date across clinical assessments
Question 3: TLG - Adverse Events Reporting
Tooling: {gtsummary}, {gt}, {ggplot2}, {pharmaverseadam}
Scripts:
question_3_tlg/01_create_ae_summary_table.R: Generates treatment-emergent adverse event (TEAE) summary table (ae_summary_table.html).
question_3_tlg/02_create_visualizations.R: Produces AE severity stacked bar chart (plot1_ae_severity.png) and Top 10 AEs plot with 95% Clopper-Pearson CIs (plot2_top10_ae.png).
🛠 Prerequisites & Installation
To run the R scripts, install the required packages:
R
install.packages(c("admiral", "sdtm.oak", "gtsummary", "gt", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "lubridate", "pharmaverseadam", "pharmaversesdtm"))
